subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – webinar confirmation email
body_text:
Hi Tara,

Thank you for speaking with us. You came to us because your webinar registration page was not sending the confirmation email.

What's now working:
- The confirmation email option in your page settings is now switched on and showing.

What we discussed:
- We explained that the same confirmation email option is available in the page settings of every page, including your second webinar page.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-F6

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
caveats: Who switched the option on is not established; stated neutrally.
